We evangelize the Lord Jesus, not our way of doing church. We want to evangelize life in his name, enrolling in his school of life, and being conformed to his likeness. That's what's given to us as his body. Paul says in 2 Corinthians 4-5, For what we proclaim is not ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, with ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake. So those are the three ways I think we can live out this value of ecclesial humility. We remember that we don't have it all figured out. We partner with other churches who may be different from us, and we evangelize Jesus and not our ideology. All right? So any thoughts or questions there?
